## Activity Hall Preset

![Activity Hall Preset icon](../../assets/icons/ActivityHallPresetComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Hall` · GUID `6bf00cd3-70b9-4337-8b80-70fc00d79666` · exposure primary

Program preset of an activity hall for sport or community use; space type ActivityHall. Every input defaults to the illustrative example values.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Name | `N` | Text | item | no | `Example Activity Hall` | Preset name; descriptive only (reports, provenance, messages), never used for matching. |
| WWR | `WWR` | Number | item | no | `0.2` | Window-to-wall ratio in [0, 1) used by the plan generator for every exterior wall. |
| Conditioned | `Cond` | Boolean | item | no | `True` | Whether the space is conditioned; the setpoints are ignored when it is not. A conditioned space needs Heating On or Cooling On. |
| Heating | `H` | Number | item | no | `18` | Constant heating setpoint, °C. |
| Cooling | `C` | Number | item | no | `25` | Constant cooling setpoint, °C. |
| Occupancy | `Occ` | Number | item | no | `0.1` | Occupancy design value, people/m². |
| Occupancy Schedule | `OccS` | [Schedule](info.md#schedule) | item | yes | – | Optional fraction schedule of Occupancy; replaces the built-in schedule 'Example Community Occupancy' when connected. |
| Lighting | `Lt` | Number | item | no | `12` | Lighting design value, W/m². |
| Lighting Schedule | `LtS` | [Schedule](info.md#schedule) | item | yes | – | Optional fraction schedule of Lighting; replaces the built-in schedule 'Example Community Hours' when connected. |
| Equipment | `Eq` | Number | item | no | `2` | Equipment design value, W/m². |
| Equipment Schedule | `EqS` | [Schedule](info.md#schedule) | item | yes | – | Optional fraction schedule of Equipment; replaces the built-in schedule 'Example Community Hours' when connected. |
| Heating On | `HOn` | Boolean | item | no | `True` | Whether a conditioned space is heated at the Heating setpoint; when false, Heating is ignored. |
| Cooling On | `COn` | Boolean | item | no | `True` | Whether a conditioned space is cooled at the Cooling setpoint; when false, Cooling is ignored. |
| WWR North | `WWRN` | Number | item | yes | – | Window-to-wall ratio in [0, 1) of the outdoor walls facing north, true azimuth [315°, 45°) after the plan's orientation. Unset: WWR. |
| WWR East | `WWRE` | Number | item | yes | – | Window-to-wall ratio in [0, 1) of the outdoor walls facing east, true azimuth [45°, 135°) after the plan's orientation. Unset: WWR. |
| WWR South | `WWRS` | Number | item | yes | – | Window-to-wall ratio in [0, 1) of the outdoor walls facing south, true azimuth [135°, 225°) after the plan's orientation. Unset: WWR. |
| WWR West | `WWRW` | Number | item | yes | – | Window-to-wall ratio in [0, 1) of the outdoor walls facing west, true azimuth [225°, 315°) after the plan's orientation. Unset: WWR. |
| Skylight Ratio | `SR` | Number | item | yes | `0` | Skylight ratio in [0, 1): a zone's roof takes one skylight of this ratio × its roof area, centred in the roof's largest grid rectangle; only roofs facing outdoors, terraces included, get skylights. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Preset | `P` | [Program Preset](info.md#program-preset) | item | The program preset. |

**Example definitions:** `foyer-halls.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/foyer-halls.png)).

## Envelope Preset

![Envelope Preset icon](../../assets/icons/EnvelopePresetComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Env` · GUID `89ebd842-fc6e-4a06-95f5-2fcfe39f08b8` · exposure primary

Envelope preset for Convert2BEM and Convert2IDF: one layered construction per envelope role (exterior wall, roof, ground floor, exposed floor, interior wall, interior floor, internal mass), the window's simple glazing, and the building's infiltration, which every zone gets at conversion from its own exterior area or volume. The constructions are the illustrative example's; every input defaults to the example values.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Name | `N` | Text | item | no | `Example Envelope` | Preset name; descriptive only (provenance, messages). |
| Glazing | `G` | Text | item | no | `Example Double Glazing` | Name of the window's glazing, also the name of the window construction. |
| U-Factor | `U` | Number | item | no | `1.8` | Window U-factor, W/(m²·K), in (0, 7]. |
| SHGC | `SHGC` | Number | item | no | `0.4` | Window solar heat gain coefficient, in (0, 1). |
| VT | `VT` | Number | item | no | `0.7` | Window visible transmittance, in (0, 1). |
| Infiltration Rate | `Inf` | Number | item | no | `0.3` | Infiltration design rate of every zone, finite and not negative, in the unit of Infiltration Basis: m³/h per m² of the zone's exterior surface area (outdoor walls, roofs, and exposed floors, windows included) or of its outdoor wall area, or air changes per hour (1/h) of its volume. |
| Infiltration Basis | `InfB` | Text | item | no | `AirChangesPerHour` | What Infiltration Rate is per: PerExteriorSurfaceArea, PerExteriorWallArea, AirChangesPerHour. Right-click the input to choose one, or extract it as a dropdown. |
| Infiltration Schedule | `InfS` | [Schedule](info.md#schedule) | item | yes | – | Optional fraction schedule multiplying Infiltration Rate; unset means always on (the example's 'Example Always On'). |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Envelope | `Env` | [Envelope Preset](info.md#envelope-preset) | item | The envelope preset. |

| Cooling | `C` | Number | item | no | `24` | Constant cooling setpoint, °C. |

## DOE Full-Service Restaurant Programs

![DOE Full-Service Restaurant Programs icon](../../assets/icons/FullServiceRestaurantProgramsComponent.png)

Component · nickname `DoeFSRP` · GUID `0efa0bdc-0cfb-4dbb-b735-7a9453fec942` · exposure secondary

The program presets of DOE Full-Service Restaurant. One preset per program key of the generator, named by its key: the loads and setpoints of the illustrative example preset of the key's space type, the window-to-wall ratio per orientation and the skylight ratio the DOE reference building has for that key's zones (0 where the key has no wall of an orientation or no roof). A key whose every zone the generator draws differently from the source (a gap, such as a zone taller than its storey drawn to the storey height) keeps the source's own ratios, so its window area differs from the source's by what the gap changes. A key whose space type has no example preset takes the example Service preset as an any-program preset, named '&lt;key&gt; (Example Service)', which the plan records in its provenance. Wire Program Map into the generator's Program Map; to change a preset, wire Keys and the edited Presets into DOE Program Map.

**Inputs**

None.

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Program Map | `Map` | [Program Map](info.md#program-map) | item | The program map, one preset per program key; wire it into the DOE generator's Program Map. |
| Keys | `K` | Text | list | The program keys of the generator (standards space types), in ordinal order: the keys of the map, and DOE Program Map's Keys. |
| Presets | `P` | [Program Preset](info.md#program-preset) | list | The preset of each key, in the order of Keys; edit one and rebuild the map with DOE Program Map. |

## DOE Primary School Programs

![DOE Primary School Programs icon](../../assets/icons/PrimarySchoolProgramsComponent.png)

Component · nickname `DoePSchP` · GUID `5f8262ad-b46c-466f-abcb-d3493099c93a` · exposure secondary

The program presets of DOE Primary School. One preset per program key of the generator, named by its key: the loads and setpoints of the illustrative example preset of the key's space type, the window-to-wall ratio per orientation and the skylight ratio the DOE reference building has for that key's zones (0 where the key has no wall of an orientation or no roof). A key whose every zone the generator draws differently from the source (a gap, such as a zone taller than its storey drawn to the storey height) keeps the source's own ratios, so its window area differs from the source's by what the gap changes. A key whose space type has no example preset takes the example Service preset as an any-program preset, named '&lt;key&gt; (Example Service)', which the plan records in its provenance. Wire Program Map into the generator's Program Map; to change a preset, wire Keys and the edited Presets into DOE Program Map.

None.
